messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired: PDR-8721 — Rapid 5xx rate increase from canary rollout (route: /v1/generate). Trigger: 5xx_rate > 3% over 2m on canary pool. Links: <https://console.redwood.ai/rollouts/rollout-742|rollout-742> <https://metrics.redwood.ai/trace/PDR-8721|metrics>
pagerduty-bot: Incident PDR-8721 created and routed to on-call. Escalation policy: canary-rollout -> eng-oncall -> eng-sre.
matt: ack — i'm oncall, looking now. @sara can you confirm if rollout was recently promoted? :eyes:
sara: yes, started canary at 12:10 UTC, traffic ramp 0->10% for v2. I paused the UI when I saw the alert but didn't fully rollback yet. I suspect the new batching patch interacts badly with small seq-lengths.
alex: checking infra logs — seeing increased 502s from runtime-hosts in us-west-2. error snippet from runtime: "kv-cache: prefix eviction race -> downstream backend timeout". looks like cache pressure + fast background eviction.
ryan: running quick checks: `kubectl -n inference logs --selector=canary=true --tail=200` shows repeated:
```
ERROR runtime: failed to fetch kv cache shard: timeout after 500ms
WARN serve: falling back to cold-run, high mem churn
```
ryan: also bump in latency p50->p95 on canary shard, correlates with 5xx spike.
sara: i'm going to set rollout traffic to 0% for v2 now. pausing + rollback if traffic doesn't drop to baseline in 2 min.
matt: go for pause, mark oncall updates in PD. matt: Updating PDR-8721: acknowledged. Investigating; rollback in progress. ETA 10m.
ryan: command to pause: `redwoodctl rollout set-traffic --id rollout-742 --variant v2=0` — executing now.
ryan: done. traffic down to 0% for v2. routing confirms old stable receives 100%.
incident-bot: Notice: Rollout traffic change detected on rollout-742: v2 -> 0% (actor: ryan). Monitoring 5xx rate for 10m window.
sara: thanks. initiating step rollback to stable image as well to stop any pending cold runs.
sara: running: `redwoodctl rollout rollback --id rollout-742 --to stable` (will take ~3m)
alex: infra note — we should drain canary pods after rollback to clear KV shards: `kubectl -n inference drain --selector=canary=true --grace-period=30`.
ryan: draining now.
ryan: drain complete, canary pods terminated. metrics stream shows 5xx rate dropping.
matt: monitoring: 5xx rate on affected route fell from 4.1% -> 0.15% over 6 minutes. latency also recovering.
emily: i'm picking this up for follow-up. putting a quick customer impact note: initial estimate — ~1.9% of requests during the 12:14–12:22 window failed with 5xx; approx 0.3% of active customers may have experienced at least one failed request. CS notified for any enterprise alerts.
sara: good capture. i'll open a postmortem and link to rollout-742 and the rollback commands. suspected root cause: kv-cache eviction parameter too aggressive with new batching code, causing hot shard eviction and backend timeouts.
alex: temporary mitigation: reduce kv-cache eviction frequency + increase per-shard timeout. we'll prepare a config patch and canary test at 1% in staging before re-ramp.
pagerduty-bot: PDR-8721: acknowledged by matt, engineers engaged. Escalation suppressed. Current status: mitigated (traffic paused + rollback) — awaiting verification.
matt: marking incident as mitigated. leaving monitoring ON for 30m. if metrics stay green i'll resolve.
emily: noted. i'll create follow-up ticket ENG-5342 for root-cause + config change + canary gating test. assigning to alex and sara.
sara: pinging release-owner checklist: add KV cache perf test to CI, include retention guardrails, update rollback playbook.
ryan: quick screenshot of metrics posted to thread: <https://metrics.redwood.ai/snapshot/abc123|metrics-snapshot>
matt: thanks team — great fast coordination. leaving the handoff to emily for post-incident ops. :white_check_mark:
emily: taking over. I'll run a 30m watch and then resolve pagerduty if steady. will post postmortem link when ready. :memo:
pagerduty-bot: PDR-8721: incident resolved by matt via manual mitigation at 12:22 UTC. Auto-close scheduled in 24h unless reopened.
incident-bot: Note: please include the exact `redwoodctl` commands used in the postmortem. Template: <https://docs.redwood.ai/ops/postmortem-template|postmortem template>.
emily: adding commands to ENG-5342. closing thread for now, will update with postmortem and timeline.
